set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot design review supplied by the user on 2026-07-23.

Problem:
Pool, pilot, and task families need related durable keys. Ad-hoc delimiters and raw startsWith queries would reintroduce stringly identity and can lose events between enumeration and subscription.

Scope and acceptance:
- Define a canonical validated SubmissionKey segment/child derivation scheme with unambiguous ancestry and total-length bounds.
- Preserve legacy root keys as one segment or provide an explicit compatibility rule.
- Use the derivation API in registered array/task lowering where related keys are generated.
- Add a bounded, deterministic, segment-aware ControlStore query.
- Return the matching current projection and an event cursor from one atomic read so attach can subscribe without an enumeration race.
- Provide in-memory and file-journal conformance tests for boundaries, pagination, collision cases, restart, and concurrent commits.
- Keep Site.attach and pool types above scala-slurm.
set.title: P6f.25: Add hierarchical submission keys and atomic prefix attachment
